entities.summary: Stephane-Franck Pascal, known professionally as MeeK, is a French-British singer, songwriter, musician and music producer. His stage name is a homage to 1960s British pop producer Joe Meek. A multi-instrumentalist, MeeK plays all the instruments on his recordings through a multitracked/multi-layered method of recording and provides all vocals including multi-layered backing harmonies.
